description: List the account's videos that are already encrypted (HLS). Videos still in an encryption batch only show up when it finishes (see panda_get_hls_encryption_batches). Returns {total, page, limit, pages, videos: [{id, title, status, folder_id, encrypted_at, available_resolutions, ...}]}. Default 25 videos per page, max 50; keep calling with page+1 while page < pages.
name: panda_list_hls_encrypted_videos
title: List HLS Encrypted Videos
